item.title: ChatGPT Rolls Out Ads, Just Hours After Anthropic's Mocking Super Bowl Commercials
item.description: OpenAI started testing ads in ChatGPT on Monday, hours after Anthropic's Super Bowl commercials mocked the idea. The $8 billion loss explains why.

item.title: Polymarket Sues Massachusetts Ahead of Looming Ban of Kalshi Sports Markets
item.description: With temporary bans of prediction markets poised to take effect in Massachusetts and Nevada, Polymarket is asking a federal court to intervene.

item.title: YouTube Star MrBeast Just Bought a Banking App—Will It Offer Crypto?
item.description: MrBeast's Beast Industries just acquired fintech startup Step, a banking platform for teens, following a crypto trademark application.

item.title: Bitcoin Miner Cango Dumps $305 Million in BTC to Fuel AI Pivot
item.description: Cango is the latest publicly traded Bitcoin miner to embrace AI, and it's fueling that push by selling a bunch of Bitcoin.

item.title: Jump Trading to Earn Stakes in Polymarket, Kalshi via Liquidity Deals: Bloomberg
item.description: Global trading firm Jump will score stakes in prediction market platforms Kalshi and Polymarket for its market-making services, per a report.

item.title: AI Promised to Save Time—Instead It's Created a New Kind of Burnout
item.description: UC-Berkeley and Yale researchers found that AI tools don't reduce work; they intensify it by creating workload creep and widespread burnout.

item.title: Fintechs Back Fed Payments Account That Could Open Rails to Crypto Firms
item.description: Fintech groups are pressing the Fed to loosen payment access for non-banks, setting up a clash with banks over risk and crypto exposure.

item.title: Is Bitcoin's Sell-Off Finally Running Out of Steam?
item.description: Bitcoin’s sell-off shows signs of easing as large buyers step in, though analysts say any rebound still depends on institutional demand.

item.title: US Sentences Fugitive to 20 Years Over $73 Million Crypto Scam
item.description: The sentence was handed down in absentia after prosecutors said the defendant cut off an ankle monitor and fled supervision.

item.title: Vitalik Buterin Calls for Ethereum-Led Alternative to the 'Race for AGI'
item.description: The Ethereum co-founder has outlined a four-quadrant Ethereum-AI buildout spanning private AI use, agent markets, and governance.
